CA.rationale: No attention/allocation relation explicitly linked to identified content.

COD.rationale: Identified content (red coordinates) and a separate organization/access status (origin) are both explicitly present and related to the same referent/time.

A.rationale: No explicit attention/allocation or content-processing condition is linked to the identified content's presentation/access.

C.rationale: The report explicitly identifies content (color 'red') with a concrete set of coordinates for a named referent and time.

D.rationale: Content (red coordinates) is presented separately from its organization/access status (origin), allowing status differentiation for the same referent/time.

O.rationale: The report states how the content is organized/accessed by giving an origin kind and represented_time for the referent.
